If not, consider doing so (e.g., taking the dog out immediately or explaining to your daughter why it’s important). - **Teaching Values:** This could be an opportunity to discuss responsibility with your daughter—why animals matter in Judaism and how actions affect others (even non-human ones). --- ### **Final Note:** Ethics aren’t about binary right/wrong but about intention, impact, and growth.
